Session date: 3:09 pm on 8 October, 2023
[D12:1] Sam: Hey Evan, hope you're doing okay. I wanted to chat about something that's been bothering me lately... [D12:2] Evan: Hey Sam, tough news. Yeah, our health can really put a damper on things. I started lifting weights one year ago and it's been a journey. It was a struggle at first, but I'm seeing some gains. You interested in trying it out?

[D12:6] Evan: No problem, Sam. Can't wait to hear about your progress. Keep up the hard work!
